def find_longest_common_subsequence(s1, s2, virus):
    n, m = len(s1), len(s2)
    dp = [["" for _ in range(m + 1)] for _ in range(n + 1)]

    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        for j in range(1, m + 1):
            if s1[i - 1] == s2[j - 1]:
                dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j - 1] + s1[i - 1]
            else:
                dp[i][j] = max(dp[i - 1][j], dp[i][j - 1], key=len)

    longest_common_subseq = dp[n][m]
    if any(virus in longest_common_subseq for virus in virus):
        return "0"
    return longest_common_subseq

# Read input
s1 = input().strip()
s2 = input().strip()
virus = input().strip()

# Find and output the result
result = find_longest_common_subsequence(s1, s2, virus)
print(result)
